package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

// scenario for route_registration_tests_duplicate_full_bootstrap_per_file: Tests that rebuild the full application bootstrap repeatedly instead of using shared test setup.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
func SetupServer() *http.ServeMux {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("/users", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Write([]byte("users list"))
	})
	return mux
}

func TestUsersEndpoint(t *testing.T) {
	mux := SetupServer()
	req := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/users", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != 200 {
		t.Errorf("expected 200, got %d", rec.Code)
	}
}

func TestUsersEndpointWithAuth(t *testing.T) {
	mux := SetupServer()
	req := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/users", nil)
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer token")
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != 200 {
		t.Errorf("expected 200, got %d", rec.Code)
	}
}
